hedging_delta.evidence: Both calls use similar forward-looking boilerplate and 'about as expected' phrasing without notable change.

guidance_direction.evidence: Prior guided Q2 revenue $3.65B-$3.95B (sequential growth); current guides Q4 revenue $3.7B-$4B, down from Q3's $4.2B actual, implying sequential decline.

quant_claim_escalation.evidence: No comparable specific forward numeric targets (TAM, capacity, customer counts) cited in both calls.

new_topic_rate.evidence: Same structure and topics (end-markets, capital management, margins) as prior call, no new initiatives introduced.

tone_delta.evidence: Current call notes 'cyclical recovery' and broad end-market growth versus prior's uniformly negative sequential declines.

demand_language_delta.evidence: Prior call: all end-markets down sequentially (industrial down upper-single digits, comms down ~25%); current: most end-markets up (auto +upper-single, personal electronics +30%, comms +25%), demand clearly strengthening.
